# Spinr

> Spinr (thespinr.com) turns a merchant's existing product photos (1-4
> angles) into an interactive 360° product spin that shoppers can drag
> with a mouse or finger on any e-commerce product page. AI-generated in
> minutes; no photography rig, no 3D modeling, no code.

## What Spinr does

- Input: the product photos a store already has (front/back/side angles).
- Backgrounds are removed automatically; AI generates a smooth 360°
  rotation with studio-style lighting.
- Output: an interactive drag-to-spin widget embedded on the product page
  (one line of HTML, or one click via the Shopify app), plus an MP4.
- Views are unlimited on every plan — pricing is per spin created, never
  per view or per visitor.

## Who it's for

Shopify and other e-commerce merchants — especially footwear, bags,
furniture, eyewear, and home goods — who want interactive 360° product
views without 360° photography rigs ($75+ per product) or 3D artists.

## Pricing

- Free: 3 spins, no card required.
- Pro: $29/month, 10 spins included, then $2.50 per extra spin. Billed
  through Shopify for Shopify merchants.
